# Young Red Dragon (`monsters:young-red-dragon`)
*Large dragon, chaotic evil* | **CR** 10 (XP 5,900; PB +4)
**AC** 18 | **HP** 178 (17d10 + 85) | **Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft.
**STR** 23 (+6) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 21 (+5) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 19 (+4)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +4, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +4
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +8, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Damage Immunities:** fire
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 18
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
- **Fire Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
